name: @heady/awareness
description: Heady Change Awareness: git-event-driven realtime codebase awareness. On every commit/merge/checkout it runs the fail-closed consistency gate, advances the Merkle-triggered embed outbox (via heady-embed), and republishes a current-state context snapshot so Heady or any external AI reads live data. Squash-merge is a NON-destructive proposal — never an unattended history rewrite.
